name: mozecek
description: Mozeček — agent memory: MCP tools (search, list, remember, recall, timeline, ask), session capture hook and memory skills.

url.title: Instance address
url.description: Base address of your Mozeček instance, no trailing slash. There is no default: a plugin carrying its publisher's address would send every install that forgot this there. Leave empty to configure it through MOZECEK_URL instead.

token.title: Agent key
token.description: The mz_… key issued for this agent. Stored in the OS keychain, never in settings.json. Leave empty to configure it through MOZECEK_TOKEN instead.

auto_capture.title: Store finished sessions
auto_capture.description: After a session ends, send your turns and the assistant's to memory. Tool output is never sent.
